canvasLabel: Canvas {size} × {size} pixels, cursor at column {x}, row {y}, tool: {tool}
canvasHelp: Paint with a mouse, finger or pen. With the keyboard: the arrow keys move the cursor (with Shift in steps of four), Space or Enter uses the tool. Ctrl+Z undoes, Ctrl+Y redoes.
sizeConfirm: A new size starts an empty {size} × {size} picture. You can bring the current one back afterwards with “Undo”.

bit1.name: 1 bit · 2 colours
bit1.note: 1 bit per pixel: every dot is on or off, black or white – the way the first Macintosh drew in 1984.

ega16.name: 4 bits · 16 colours
ega16.note: 4 bits per pixel make 16 colours: the CGA and EGA palette of the IBM PC. Built from red, green, blue and one brightness bit – only colour 6 was turned into brown by the monitor.

vga256.name: 8 bits · 256 colours
vga256.note: 8 bits per pixel make 256 colours at once, as in the VGA mode of 1987. The program chose which 256; here they are the 16 above, a colour cube and greys.

memory: This picture needs {bytes} bytes of memory like this ({size} × {size} pixels × {depth} bits).
saveNote: The picture is saved in this browser only and never uploaded. The download is made right here on your device.
saveFailed: Autosave is not possible in this browser right now. You can keep painting and download the picture.

announce.picked: Picked colour {color}, back to the pencil.
announce.palette: Palette changed: {name}. Every colour was replaced by the closest one.
